nodes.label: Copy-based (not symlinked) skill deployment
nodes.rationale: ~/.claude/skills/flora-batch/ is an independent copy of skills/flora-batch/; editing the repo does not update a live installed skill until it is re-copied, because skills are discovered at session start rather than hot-reloaded.

nodes.label: Correction: no auto file-bridge for oversized execute output
nodes.rationale: The previously documented rule that oversized execute results auto-save to a local file is false — the MCP server hard-errors 'Output exceeded 100000 bytes' with no file path. Fix: keep returns small (~10 reservations/call), write files locally yourself, and rely on upload.py's HTTP-status check plus optional floralib.validate_gcs_reservation linting as the real safety net for hand-transcribed signed data.

nodes.label: BCI Flora Skills
nodes.rationale: Internal-use-only skill library delivered by Pierrepont Advisors for the BCI AI photo pipeline; portable by design with no hardcoded accounts, workspace IDs, or file paths so each teammate uses their own Flora connector and credits.

nodes.label: flora-batch Skill
nodes.rationale: Runs a single Flora technique across an entire folder of images, resumable via checkpoint, with a mandatory cost gate before any spend. Deployed copy-based (cp -R into ~/.claude/skills/), not symlinked, so fixes require re-copying.

nodes.label: Flora MCP Connector
nodes.rationale: Ships project-scoped .mcp.json so Claude Code detects the flora server automatically; OAuth runs on first tool call, no API key; server id differs per person/session so it must never be hardcoded.

nodes.label: Cost Gate (README)
nodes.rationale: Cost = (number of runs) x run_cost; per-image techniques bill once per image, compose techniques once per look. User approval is required before any spend.

nodes.label: Garment QA (README)
nodes.rationale: Uses Claude's own vision so it spends no Flora credits; per-image batches only in v1, compose runs unsupported.

nodes.label: Garment QA Comparison Spec
nodes.rationale: BCI's photo pipeline feeds real product listings, so an inaccurate garment render is a real-world defect, not an aesthetic nit; nothing previously checked Flora output against the input photo before shipping.

nodes.label: Color Rubric
nodes.rationale: Compares hue family rather than exact colorimetry because Claude's vision is not calibrated for pixel-level precision; verdicts: match / minor_shift / mismatch.

nodes.label: Construction Rubric
nodes.rationale: Distinguishes hallucinations (features added) from omissions (features missing) as separate failure modes worth separating in the report; verdicts: match / minor_deviation / mismatch.

nodes.label: Claude-Vision Judgment Step
nodes.rationale: Deliberately a Claude-vision qualitative judgment, not a new ML model, library, or MCP dependency; inherently non-deterministic and cannot be meaningfully unit-tested — calibration is validated by spot-checking known-good and known-bad pairs instead of pretending a test exists.

nodes.label: resolve_qa_pairs (spec)
nodes.rationale: Maps each output back to its input via the existing batch_state.json record — a lookup, not new tracking; pure, network-free, fully unit-testable, matching the rest of floralib.

nodes.label: resolve_qa_pairs_compose (deferred)
nodes.rationale: Deferred out of v1 (spec Open Question 1) because no reliable universal rule maps compose output_id to role — naming varies per technique; recommendation was to ship per-image QA first with compose QA as a fast-follow.

nodes.label: QA Report Artifacts (qa_report.json/.md)
nodes.rationale: Machine-readable JSON plus human-readable Markdown plus a concise chat summary of only flagged items — not a full dump — matching how SKILL.md's auto-review step already summarizes results.

nodes.label: Chat-Driven Trigger
nodes.rationale: No new UI: the user names liked outputs in the Claude Code conversation and QA runs on just that subset, matching how the rest of flora-batch is orchestrated — the chat is the interface.

nodes.label: Garment QA Comparison Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Seven TDD tasks; v1 scoped to per-image batches only, Python 3.9+ stdlib only, zero additional Flora spend; qa_resolve.py/qa_report.py deliberately get smoke tests rather than unit tests because CLI plumbing is thin and logic is covered via floralib tests.

nodes.label: floralib.resolve_qa_pairs
nodes.rationale: Any selected name not found in state is surfaced under 'unresolved', never silently dropped or guessed at.

nodes.label: floralib.qa_overall_flag
nodes.rationale: True unless BOTH checks are a clean 'match' — keeps the flag decision deterministic instead of asking Claude to self-report it.

nodes.label: flora-batch Hardening Round 2 Plan
nodes.rationale: Closes seven correctness/safety gaps from the 2026-07-31 code review: output re-enqueue footgun, positional reservation pairing, non-atomic state writes, curl -F injection surface, legacy review tooling, unvalidated QA verdict vocabulary, and partial QA manifests. All commands run from an isolated git worktree because a prior task polluted a branch from the main checkout.

nodes.label: floralib.save_json_atomic
nodes.rationale: Temp-file + os.replace so an interrupt can never leave a truncated file — the state files are the pipeline's only checkpoint, and a half-written batch_state.json loses the whole batch's recovery story. Temp file lives in the same directory so os.replace stays atomic.

nodes.label: floralib.is_output_artifact
nodes.rationale: The 'same' output convention writes outputs into the input folder, so re-running init.py there would enumerate prior outputs as new pending items and pay to run the technique on its own outputs — a money footgun.

nodes.label: floralib.match_reservations
nodes.rationale: Replaces the positional-list reservations format, where a same-length wrong-order file silently paired the wrong asset_id with the wrong image; keying by rel makes the file self-describing and partial re-reservation natural. Breaking format change documented in SKILL.md in the same task.

nodes.label: floralib.build_curl_upload_args
nodes.rationale: curl -F treats a leading '@' or '<' in a value as 'read this local file'; reservation form fields are server-supplied, so --form-string sends them literally (injection guard). Only the file part uses -F, and it goes LAST as required by S3/GCS presigned POST.

nodes.label: floralib.validate_qa_results
nodes.rationale: Verdict typos would flag conservatively downstream (qa_overall_flag treats any non-'match' as flagged) but corrupt the machine-readable report a consuming app relies on — so catch them against the canonical vocabulary before writing.

nodes.label: contact_sheet.groups_from_state
nodes.rationale: Relative paths keep the gallery portable since it lives at state['output']/_contact_sheet.html.

nodes.label: Legacy review.py Removal
nodes.rationale: SKILL.md said 'prefer contact_sheet.py' but that tool only handled compose runs; per-image batches were stuck on legacy review.py (remote URLs + headless Chrome). One tool, two modes; delete the legacy one.

nodes.label: Cost Gate (MANDATORY)
nodes.rationale: Never spend without showing (number of runs) x run_cost = total and waiting for explicit approval. Uploads are free; only the run phase spends. Compose: one look = one run — never multiply by output count or file count. No balance pre-check API exists; a 402 insufficient_credits (which does not charge) is the only balance signal.

nodes.label: batch_state.json Checkpoint
nodes.rationale: Bridges the sandbox and local worlds; every pipeline phase writes it, making the whole batch resumable. Per-image record: rel, stem, out_subdir, stage, asset_id, run_id, outputs[], files[], error; stages pending -> uploaded -> run_started -> outputs_ready -> done (or run_failed / run_blocked).

nodes.label: Workspace Billing
nodes.rationale: Two run routes bill differently: techniques.runs.create bills the DEFAULT workspace (no workspace_id param); runs.startTechnique bills a chosen workspace and its inputs is an id->value map, not an array. Poll startTechnique runs with generations.retrieve — the nested retrieve 404s. Assets are portable across workspaces.

nodes.label: Compose (Multi-Input) Techniques
nodes.rationale: Detected when technique.inputs has more than one input id; one run consumes several role inputs (e.g. top/bottom/shoes) and outputs per run are free — the price is flat per run.

nodes.label: Garment QA (SKILL.md section)
nodes.rationale: Runs after the user picks favorites; zero additional Flora spend (no MCP run/technique calls — only local file reads plus Claude's vision); relay only flagged items to the user; if a detail isn't clearly visible, say so in notes instead of forcing a verdict.

nodes.label: Hard-Won Rules
nodes.rationale: Each rule caused a real production failure: hardcoded ImageKit uploader silently broke when Flora switched to GCS; a 38-image upload outran the ~15-min URL window; 35 concurrent 4K runs produced 18 timeouts; padding execute output to force a file save just errors at 100 KB.

nodes.label: Idempotency Keys
nodes.rationale: Same key = safe re-submit of the same attempt after 502/timeout (no double charge); a run that actually FAILED needs a NEW key to re-execute — the same key would only return the dead run. Failed runs are not billed.

nodes.label: Upload Backend Detection (ImageKit vs GCS)
nodes.rationale: The backend is not fixed — read reservation.upload.url + form_fields fresh every time and send exactly those fields with the file part LAST; a hardcoded ImageKit uploader silently captured nulls the day Flora switched to GCS.

nodes.label: 100 KB execute Output Cap
nodes.rationale: execute output hard-caps at 100,000 bytes and ERRORS — there is no auto-save/file bridge. Keep returns small (~10 rel-keyed reservations fit), write JSON files locally yourself, and rely on upload.py's HTTP-status check as the safety net for transcription errors.

nodes.label: Sandbox Isolation Constraint
nodes.rationale: FLORA's compute runs in an isolated sandbox that cannot read local files or reach the public internet — the core constraint that shapes everything: uploads and downloads happen via the local shell's curl against signed URLs, and the two worlds are bridged by the checkpointed batch_state.json.

nodes.label: floralib.py
nodes.rationale: All pure, network-free, unit-tested helpers live here (host-aware download variants, cost estimate, file->role mapping, reservation lint, compose-state builder); CLI scripts stay thin wrappers over it.

nodes.label: contact_sheet.py
nodes.rationale: Portable self-contained review gallery, two modes (per-image --state, compose --dir/--outputs); relative img refs, opens by double-click, no headless Chrome.

nodes.label: qa_resolve.py
nodes.rationale: Writes qa_manifest.json only when EVERY pick resolves — unresolved/ambiguous picks exit 1 with no manifest, so a partial manifest can never silently shrink QA coverage.
